feats.name: Survivor
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on rolls to resist exhaustion, starvation, and environmental hazards.

feats.name: Tough as Nails
feats.effect: Gain +2 HP per level.

feats.name: Jack of All Trades
feats.effect: Gain two additional skill proficiencies of your choice.

feats.name: Shielded Mind
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on saves against charm, possession, or mental domination.

feats.name: Fleet-Footed
feats.effect: Your movement speed increases by 5 feet and you ignore difficult terrain when dashing.

feats.name: Silver Tongue
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on Deception and Persuasion checks.

feats.name: Hardy Constitution
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on resisting Poisoned and Diseased conditions.

feats.name: Roll Out
feats.effect: You can use your reaction to halve falling damage.

feats.name: Locksmith
feats.effect: Gain Major Advantage on lockpicking and can pick magic locks with a TN 12 Spellcasting check.

feats.name: Ghost Step
feats.effect: Once per short rest, you may pass through one enemy’s space without provoking opportunity attacks.

feats.name: Savage Momentum
feats.effect: Once per turn, if you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, gain +10 feet movement.

feats.name: Unshakable
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on all saves against Fear and Intimidation effects.

feats.name: Ambusher
feats.effect: When attacking from hiding, gain Major Advantage on your attack roll.

feats.name: Mind of Steel
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on all rolls to resist mind control, illusions, and magical fear.

feats.name: Escape Artist
feats.effect: You can escape any non-magical bonds, manacles, or grapples without rolling.

feats.name: Resilient Will
feats.effect: Once per long rest, you automatically pass a saving throw against Charm or Fear.

feats.name: Defiant Warrior
feats.effect: When reduced to 0 HP, roll with Major Advantage. On success, regain 1D6 HP instead of falling unconscious.

feats.name: Perfect Timing
feats.effect: Once per short rest, you may delay your turn to act at any point in the round.

feats.name: Arcane Initiate
feats.effect: Gain Spellcasting Proficiency, a pool of 4 SP, and learn two Basic spells. Further spells can be learned through Training.

feats.name: Arcane Adept
feats.effect: Gain +4 SP and learn one Basic or Advanced spell. You may now cast Advanced spells.

feats.name: Touched by Faith
feats.effect: Choose a patron god. Gain a pool of 4 SP (shared with any spell pool you already have) and the ability to cast Basic Miracles.

feats.name: Ritualist
feats.effect: You can perform any Ritual spell or Miracle from a written rite without Spellcasting Proficiency, without Disadvantage, though it takes twice as long.

feats.name: Spellbreaker
feats.effect: When a creature within 5ft casts a spell, make a melee attack against it as a reaction. On a hit, it must pass a TN 10 concentration check or the spell fails (its SP is still spent).

feats.name: Conditioned Mind
feats.pre: Intellect +2 or Charisma +2; Tier 4 Training only
feats.effect: Brutal conditioning has taught you to recognise psionic intrusion. The Hado no longer imposes Major Disadvantage on your saves, and you gain Advantage on Willpower saves against Enchantment.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.effect: Once per session, reroll any one roll: your own, or one made against you. Does not stack with Lucky Stars or Adaptive Heritage.

feats.name: Field Medic
feats.effect: Once per short rest, spend 1 minute tending a creature to restore 1D6 + Intellect HP. You stabilise a creature at 0 HP without rolling.

feats.name: Linguist
feats.effect: Learn two additional languages, and gain Advantage on checks to decipher codes, ciphers and unfamiliar scripts.

feats.name: Mounted Combatant
feats.effect: While mounted, gain Advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount, and you may take any hit aimed at your mount instead.

feats.name: Weapon Training
feats.effect: Gain proficiency with one weapon category you lack, or with all crossbows or all firearms. May be taken more than once.

feats.name: Armour Training
feats.effect: Gain proficiency in the next armour category above the highest you have (Light, then Medium, then Heavy), or with Shields. May be taken more than once.

feats.name: Powerful Strikes
feats.effect: Add +2 to a damage roll once per turn.

feats.name: Armour Mastery
feats.effect: Add +1 to your TN when wearing Medium or Heavy armour.

feats.name: Riposte
feats.effect: When an enemy misses you with a melee attack, make a counterattack as a reaction once per encounter.

feats.name: Dual Wield
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on your second attack when dual-wielding Light Weapons.

feats.name: Shield Wall
feats.effect: Negate 1 damage from every attack when wielding a shield and gain Major Advantage on Strength checks to shove enemies.

feats.name: Tactical Insight
feats.effect: Once per round, grant an ally within 20ft Major Advantage on their next attack or saving throw.

feats.name: Combat Roll
feats.effect: Once per turn, after making a melee attack, you may move 5 feet as a free action. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

feats.name: Overpower
feats.effect: Knock a target Prone on a successful melee attack (TN 12 to resist).

feats.name: Quick Reflex
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on Initiative Rolls and attacks of opportunity.

feats.name: Brawler
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on unarmed strikes, grapples, and improvised weapon attacks. You may deal 1D6+Strength damage with fists.

feats.name: Fencing Stance
feats.effect: Add +2 to attack rolls when wielding a single weapon with no shield.

feats.name: Specialist Training
feats.effect: Pick a weapon type: slashing, bludgeoning, or piercing. When you use weapons of that type, you get +1 to hit and +1 to damage.

feats.name: Unstoppable Force
feats.effect: Once per encounter, move 10 feet and make an attack with Major Advantage. If you hit, deal +2D6 damage.

feats.name: Defensive Stance
feats.effect: Once per encounter, use a reaction to add +2 to your TN until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Last Stand
feats.effect: When reduced to 0 HP, make a TN 12 roll. On success, regain 1D6 HP instead of falling unconscious.

feats.name: Twist The Knife
feats.effect: Once per encounter, you may reroll one damage die and take the higher result. You regain this ability when you score a Critical Hit.

feats.name: Immovable Object
feats.effect: When wearing Medium or Heavy armor, you may use your reaction to automatically succeed a Dexterity save once per short rest.

feats.name: Trip Attack
feats.effect: Knock a target prone on a successful melee attack (TN 12 to resist). If you roll Major Advantage on the attack, they suffer Disadvantage on the save.

feats.name: Back To Back
feats.effect: When adjacent to an ally, both you and the ally gain +1 TN.

feats.name: Risky Play
feats.effect: Add +1D6 damage to your melee attacks but take -2 TN until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Shield Breaker
feats.effect: Your attacks ignore shield-based TN bonuses.

feats.name: Dirty Trick
feats.effect: Once per encounter, impose Major Disadvantage on an enemy’s next attack after hitting them.

feats.name: Iron Grip
feats.effect: You cannot be disarmed or knocked prone unless failing a TN 16 check.

feats.name: Heavy Strikes
feats.effect: Your melee attacks deal +2 damage when using two-handed weapons.

feats.name: Cleave
feats.effect: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, make another attack against an adjacent enemy.

feats.name: Extra Attack
feats.effect: Once per round, make an additional melee attack as part of your action.

feats.name: Phalanx
feats.effect: Allies within 5ft gain +1 to their TN while you are wielding a shield.

feats.name: Precision Strike
feats.effect: Once per encounter, roll with Major Advantage on an attack.

feats.name: Sixth Sense
feats.effect: Gain Major Advantage on initiative rolls and cannot be surprised while conscious.

feats.name: Furious Charge
feats.effect: Add +1D6 damage to your charge attack and force the target to make a TN 12 Strength check or be knocked prone.

feats.name: Rhythmic Momentum
feats.effect: If you hit with a melee attack, gain Advantage on your next attack against the same target.

feats.name: Hard To Kill
feats.effect: Gain +1 TN permanently.

feats.name: Fury of Blades
feats.effect: When dual-wielding, make a second attack with your off-hand weapon once per encounter.

feats.name: Rallying Cry
feats.effect: Allies within 10 feet regain 1D6 HP when you reduce an enemy to 0 HP.

feats.name: Executioner’s Blow
feats.effect: If an enemy is below half health, you deal +2D6 damage.

feats.name: Tactical Mastery
feats.effect: Once per encounter, take an extra turn after your current one.

feats.name: Indomitable
feats.effect: Once per encounter, reroll a failed saving throw with Major Advantage.

feats.name: Battlefield Commander
feats.effect: Allies within 10ft gain +2 to attack rolls and gain an extra 10ft of movement during the first round of combat.

feats.name: Storm of Steel
feats.effect: When dual-wielding, once per encounter make a third attack in the same turn without penalty.

feats.name: Rallying Banner
feats.effect: When Rallying Cry triggers, allies regain 2D6 HP instead and gain +1 to attack rolls until the end of their next turn.

feats.name: Guardian's Oath
feats.effect: As a reaction when an adjacent ally is hit, take the hit in their place and reduce its damage by 2.

feats.name: Veteran’s Instinct
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on all attacks against targets you’ve already hit this combat.

feats.name: Bulwark Stance
feats.effect: While wielding a shield, you cannot be moved, knocked prone, or disarmed.

feats.name: Overwhelming Might
feats.effect: If you miss an attack by 1 or 2, roll 1D6. If the result is 4+, the attack hits instead.

feats.name: Precision Tactician
feats.effect: Once per encounter, give Advantage to an ally’s next attack, movement, or saving throw.

feats.name: Final Blow
feats.effect: Once per long rest, deal triple damage if attacking a target below half HP.

feats.name: Adaptive Actions
feats.effect: If you miss an attack, gain Advantage on your next attack against the same target.

feats.name: Siege Master
feats.effect: You deal double damage to objects, structures, and fortifications.

feats.name: Avatar of War
feats.effect: Gain a third attack each turn and add +2D6 to all critical hits.

feats.name: Inexorable
feats.effect: Once per encounter, ignore your target’s TN for all attacks this round.

feats.name: Sunder
feats.effect: Your attacks now permanently weaken enemy armor. Each hit against an armored enemy reduces their TN by 1 for the rest of combat.

feats.name: Endless Onslaught
feats.effect: Each time you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, move up to 10 feet and make another attack without provoking an attack of opportunity.

feats.name: Bulwark
feats.effect: When equipped with a shield, reduce all physical damage by half. Additionally, if an enemy misses an attack, you can use your reaction to shove them 5 feet away.

feats.name: Warlord’s Presence
feats.effect: Allies within 30 feet gain +1 to attack rolls and saving throws and an additional 10ft of movement speed while you are in combat.

feats.name: Executioner
feats.effect: When an enemy is at half HP or lower, your melee attacks gain Advantage.

feats.name: Unstoppable
feats.effect: When reduced to 0 HP, roll 2D6. If the result is 8 or higher, regain 2D6 + Fighter Level HP instead of falling unconscious.

feats.name: Onslaught
feats.effect: Instead of making an extra attack after killing a foe, you can move 15 feet and make two additional attacks.

feats.name: Titan Killer
feats.effect: Against all creatures at least one size larger than you, deal +1D6 extra damage and ignore 2 points of TN.

feats.name: Weapon Saint
feats.effect: With weapons of your chosen type, you score a Critical Success on a natural 11 or 12.

feats.name: Living Legend
feats.effect: Once per long rest, when you or an ally within 30ft would fail a roll, declare it a success instead. Enemies who witness it must pass a TN 14 Willpower save or become Shaken.

feats.name: Arcane Focus
feats.effect: Gain +1 to spell attack rolls when using an Arcane Focus.

feats.name: Spelldrinker
feats.effect: Once per encounter, cast a Tier 1 spell without spending spell points.

feats.name: Elemental Affinity
feats.effect: Choose an element (fire, frost, lightning). Once per short rest, add +1D6 damage of that element to a spell.

feats.name: Runescribe
feats.effect: You can identify magical runes and glyphs without rolling.

feats.name: Spellflash
feats.effect: Once per encounter, cast a spell as a Minor Action.

feats.name: Mana Tap
feats.effect: Once per encounter, regain 2 spell points after landing a successful spell attack.

feats.name: Arcane Reservoir
feats.effect: Gain +3 spell points once per long rest.

feats.name: Eldritch Insight
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on Arcana checks to identify spells and magical items.

feats.name: Focus Casting
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on concentration checks to maintain spells.

feats.name: Arcane Shell
feats.effect: Once per encounter, reduce incoming magical damage by 1D6.

feats.name: Glyphwright
feats.effect: You may store a single Tier 1 spell as a magical sigil on an object or surface, activated as a Major Action. Once activated, the sigil vanishes.

feats.name: Quickspell
feats.effect: Once per encounter, immediately cast a reaction spell without using an action.

feats.name: Countermage
feats.effect: Once per encounter, counter a spell without spending points OR negate a spell effect within 10ft.

feats.name: Warded Up
feats.effect: Gain +1 TN against magical attacks.

feats.name: Calm & Composed
feats.effect: Gain Major Advantage on concentration checks for maintaining spells.

feats.name: Enchanter
feats.effect: You may enchant items without rare components if the effect is Tier 1 or lower.

feats.name: Mage Armour
feats.effect: Once per long rest, create a magical barrier giving +2 TN for one encounter.

feats.name: Arcane Sight
feats.effect: Detect the presence of magical auras, enchantments, and hidden spells within 30ft without casting a spell.

feats.name: Leyline Tapping
feats.effect: Once per short rest, regain 2 spell points by meditating for 1 minute.

feats.name: Mystic Precision
feats.effect: Add +1 to all spell damage rolls.

feats.name: Wardweaver
feats.effect: Extend the duration of magical barriers and defensive spells by one additional round.

feats.name: Spellweave Armor
feats.effect: When wearing no armor, gain +1 TN.

feats.name: Essence Drain
feats.effect: When an enemy fails a saving throw invoked by one of your spells, regain a spell point.

feats.name: School Specialist
feats.effect: Choose a school of magic. Gain +1 on casting rolls for spells of that school, and creatures suffer -1 on saves to resist them.

feats.name: Twin Spells
feats.effect: Once per encounter, target two creatures with a single-target spell, but the second target takes half damage or effect.

feats.name: Arcane Efficiency
feats.effect: Once per long rest, regain 3 spell points instantly.

feats.name: Elemental Surge
feats.effect: Once per short rest, add +2D6 extra damage of your chosen element to a spell.

feats.name: Arcane Explosion
feats.effect: Once per encounter, when hit in melee, release a burst of energy dealing 2D6 damage in a 10ft radius.

feats.name: Silent Casting
feats.effect: Ignore the verbal component of any spell or ritual.

feats.name: Spell Bending
feats.effect: Once per encounter, redirect an incoming spell to a different target within range.

feats.name: Arcane Mastery
feats.effect: Once per day, cast a spell without spending spell points.

feats.name: Now You See Me
feats.effect: You can cast a spell and move in the same action without incurring attacks of opportunity.

feats.name: Runic Amplification
feats.effect: When casting a spell using a stored rune, increase its effect by 50%.

feats.name: Dimensional Rift
feats.effect: Once per encounter, teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see or have recently seen.

feats.name: Surging Power
feats.effect: Once per encounter, when rolling damage for a spell, reroll all damage die and take the highest.

feats.name: Echo of Magic
feats.effect: Once per long rest, if a spell fails due to a counterspell or resistance, cast it again immediately without expending spell points.

feats.name: Master of Elements
feats.effect: Once per encounter, change a spell’s damage type to fire, frost, or lightning, ignoring resistances.

feats.name: Arcane Overload
feats.effect: Once per long rest, double a spell’s damage, but take 2D6 recoil damage.

feats.name: Weaver’s Tempo
feats.effect: You can cast two different spells up to Tier 2 in a single action once per encounter.

feats.name: Rune Lord
feats.effect: You may store two spells in a rune instead of one.

feats.name: Greater Counterspell
feats.effect: Counterspell now affects spells of any tier, but requires an Arcana check (TN 10 + spell tier).

feats.name: Arcane Phasing
feats.effect: You may pass through solid objects when teleporting.

feats.name: Void Tap
feats.effect: Once per long rest, restore spell points equal to half the damage dealt by a spell.

feats.name: Improved Spellweave
feats.effect: When wearing no armour, gain +3 TN.

feats.name: Trained Mind
feats.effect: Immune to charm, fear, and confusion. You also automatically succeed on concentration unless unconscious.

feats.name: Signature Move
feats.effect: Choose three spells you know; they become innately known to you, requiring no components and costing 1 SP less to cast.

feats.name: Weaver’s Echo
feats.effect: Once per long rest, you may cast the same spell twice in a single action, targeting different creatures or areas.

feats.name: Necrotic Channel
feats.effect: Whenever you successfully land a spell on a target, gain 1 temporary HP per spell point spent (max 10/round).

feats.name: Arcane Transcendence
feats.effect: Once per day, cast any Tier 1–3 spell without spending spell points, and the spell is cast at Master scaling for free.

feats.name: Spell Eater
feats.effect: Once per day, when you successfully counter a spell, regain the same number of spell points it would have cost.

feats.name: Echo Caster
feats.effect: The first time you cast a spell each combat, you may repeat it on the next turn without spending points.

feats.name: Voidheart
feats.effect: Whenever you kill a creature with a spell, regain 1D6 spell points (max once per round).

feats.name: Mindjolt
feats.effect: Casting a spell also causes 1D6 psychic damage to anyone who can see you cast it. You may selectively shield allies from this effect.

feats.name: Archmage
feats.effect: Spells of your specialist school cost 1 less SP (minimum 1), and you may apply one Basic scaling option to them for free.

feats.name: Power Cast
feats.effect: Once per day, cast any known spell without components or counters—it simply happens.

feats.name: Death Signal
feats.effect: Once per encounter, when a creature dies within 30ft, you may cast a spell as a free reaction.

feats.name: Back At Ya'
feats.effect: Once per day, reflect a spell back at its caster without a roll. The spell must be Tier 3 or lower.

feats.name: Different Reality
feats.effect: You now exist slightly out of sync. The first attack or spell that targets you each encounter automatically misses.

feats.name: Final Thought
feats.effect: When reduced to 0 HP, you may speak one phrase and cast one final spell as a reaction, even if unconscious.

feats.name: Copycat
feats.effect: You may cast any spell you’ve seen cast in the past 24 hours, even if you do not know it. It costs +2 SP and cannot be upscaled.

feats.name: Weight of the Oath
feats.effect: Oaths have mechanical significance. Breaking an Oath removes divine abilities for 24 hours. While upholding faith, gain Advantage on Willpower saves.

feats.name: Hands of the Martyr
feats.effect: When an ally within 10 feet drops to 0 HP, you can take the remaining damage instead.

feats.name: Righteous Fury
feats.effect: Gain Major Advantage on an attack against an enemy who harmed a helpless creature.

feats.name: Shield of Conviction
feats.effect: Increase TN by +1 while wearing armor.

feats.name: Divine Channel
feats.effect: Once per long rest, cast a Miracle without spending Spell Points.

feats.name: Sacred Armaments
feats.effect: Your melee weapon is considered magical and deals +1 Radiant damage.

feats.name: Commanding Presence
feats.effect: You can issue a single-word command (e.g., Halt, Drop, Flee). Non-hostile creatures within 30ft must make a TN 12 Willpower save or obey.

feats.name: Defiance
feats.effect: Gain Advantage on rolls against being Frightened or Charmed.

feats.name: Steel Conviction
feats.effect: Taking damage while conscious grants +1 to attack rolls until end of next turn.

feats.name: Gifted Healer
feats.effect: Once per long rest, remove a Disease, or Poison from a creature you touch.

feats.name: Blessed Endurance
feats.effect: Gain +2 TN against Exhaustion, Necrotic Drain, and effects that reduce max HP.

feats.name: Battlepriest's Stance
feats.effect: When wielding a melee weapon, you can use your reaction to impose Disadvantage on an enemy’s attack against an ally within 5ft.

feats.name: Condemn the False
feats.effect: Once per long rest, force a creature to make a TN 12 Willpower save or be Shaken for 1 minute.

feats.name: Divine Restitution
feats.effect: Once per encounter, deal 2D6 Radiant damage to an enemy who has struck you.

feats.name: Armor of the Faithful
feats.effect: While wearing armor, you cannot be grappled, or knocked prone unless hit by a Critical Hit

feats.name: Tenacious Advance
feats.effect: Once per encounter, if you take the Dash action, you may make one melee attack as part of the movement.

feats.name: Blessed Weapon
feats.effect: Your melee weapon deals +1D6 Radiant damage against the Undead and Fiends.

feats.name: Righteous Smite
feats.effect: Once per turn, after hitting a creature, you may spend 1 SP to deal +1D6 Radiant damage.

feats.name: Retributive Strike
feats.effect: When an enemy within melee range attacks an ally, you can use your reaction to strike them before their attack resolves.

feats.name: Divine Aura
feats.effect: Allies within 10 feet gain Advantage on saving throws against mind-affecting magic.

feats.name: Miracle Infusion
feats.effect: When casting a Miracle, you may spend +1 SP to heal an ally within 10ft for 1D6 HP.

feats.name: Steadfast Guardian
feats.effect: Allies within 10 feet cannot be Frightened while you are conscious.

feats.name: Sacred Recovery
feats.effect: When you succeed on a Willpower saving throw, regain 1D6 HP (once per round).

feats.name: Sentinel of Faith
feats.effect: When standing still, gain +1 TN against attacks and Advantage against forced movement.

feats.name: Unbroken Line
feats.effect: Allies within 10 feet cannot be Shoved or Pulled unless they choose to be.

feats.name: Hand of Ordination
feats.effect: Once per long rest, anoint an ally (or yourself) as a Divine Champion. They gain Advantage on attacks against enemies of your faith. Only one champion at a time.

feats.name: Judgment is Passed
feats.effect: Once per combat, reroll a missed attack against an enemy that harmed an ally.

feats.name: Banner of the Righteous
feats.effect: Once per combat, plant your weapon in the ground—allies within 10ft gain +2 TN and Advantage on saves.

feats.name: Sanctuary of the Devout
feats.effect: Once per long rest, create a 15ft divine barrier that grants resistance to all damage for 1 round.

feats.name: Piercing Light
feats.effect: Your Radiant attacks ignore resistances.

feats.name: Defender of the Faith
feats.effect: When an enemy critically hits you, gain +2 TN until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Sacrificial Shield
feats.effect: As a reaction, take half damage in place of an ally within 10ft. If you block a critical hit, your shield is damaged.

feats.name: Martyr’s Resolve
feats.effect: When reduced to 0 HP, stay conscious for 1 extra round before falling.

feats.name: Divine Might
feats.effect: Your melee attacks deal +1D6 Radiant or Necrotic damage, and you may add this damage to a Miracle attack.

feats.name: Guiding Light
feats.effect: Once per encounter, grant an ally within 10ft Advantage on their next saving throw.

feats.name: Holy Rebuke
feats.effect: When a creature targets you with a spell, force them to make a TN 12 Willpower save or take 2D6 Radiant damage.

feats.name: Avatar of Judgment
feats.effect: Once per encounter, force an enemy to make a TN 14 Willpower save or suffer Major Disadvantage on all rolls for 3 rounds.

feats.name: Divine Retribution
feats.effect: Once per encounter, when critically hit, strike back with a guaranteed critical hit.

feats.name: Cleansing Touch
feats.effect: Once per long rest, remove all conditions from a willing creature.

feats.name: Paragon of Faith
feats.effect: Immune to Frightened, Charmed, and Mind Control effects. Gain Advantage on saves against divine magic.

feats.name: Unyielding Will
feats.effect: You automatically succeed on saving throws against Charm and Fear effects.

feats.name: Faith’s Bastion
feats.effect: Allies within 10ft gain Advantage against Necrotic, Psychic, and Mind-Affecting effects.

feats.name: Retribution’s Edge
feats.effect: When you kill an enemy, gain +1 to attack rolls until the end of combat.

feats.name: Banish the Unclean

feats.name: Divine Ward
feats.effect: Once per long rest, create a 15ft ward that grants resistance to all damage and blocks teleportation for 1 minute.

feats.name: Miraculous Intervention
feats.effect: Once per long rest, when an ally within 30ft drops to 0 HP, they instantly regain 3D6 HP.

feats.name: Rite of the Anointed
feats.effect: Your Divine Champion also gains +2 TN, and their Advantage now applies against every enemy, not only enemies of your faith.

feats.name: Shield of the Martyr

feats.name: Beacon of the Faithful
feats.effect: Allies within 30ft gain +1 TN and Advantage on Willpower saves as long as you stand.

feats.name: Divine Aegis
feats.effect: Allies within 15ft gain resistance to all magic damage and have Advantage on dispelling effects.

feats.name: Oathkeeper’s Vow
feats.effect: If you take an Oath, choose a Virtue (e.g., Justice, Protection). Once per encounter, invoke it to gain Advantage on all rolls for 1 round.

feats.name: Radiant Fury
feats.effect: When casting a Miracle, spend +2 SP to deal an additional 3D6 Radiant or Necrotic damage to all enemies within 10ft of the target.

feats.name: Ascendant Revival
feats.effect: Once per long rest, if you are reduced to 0 HP, you instead drop to 1 HP and heal 5D6 HP.

feats.name: Champion of the Pantheon
feats.effect: You may Ordain up to two warriors at the same time.

feats.name: Wrath of the Heavens

feats.name: Immovable Faith

feats.name: Eternal Sentinel

spells.effect: 4D6 Fire damage in a 20ft radius, leaves Molten Terrain (2 rounds), inflicts Burning (1 round, TN 14 to resist).

spells.name: Renewal
spells.effect: A creature regains 4D6 HP and is cured of Crippled, Blinded, Deafened and one tier of Exhausted.

spells.name: Dawnfire
spells.effect: A column of dawn-light 20ft wide: allies inside regain 3D6 HP, while Undead and Fiends inside take 4D6 Radiant damage (TN 14 to resist for half).

spells.name: Phantom Sound
spells.effect: Create a realistic but illusory sound within range. Cannot cause physical harm. Lasts 1 min.
spells.scaling: Range, Duration, Effect: Louder and more complex sounds with additional SP.

spells.name: Minor Image
spells.effect: Create a small static visual illusion (object, symbol, or image). Cannot move or make noise. Lasts 1 min.
spells.scaling: Range, Area, Effect: Allows small movements or simple animations.

spells.name: Distract
spells.effect: A targeted creature glances away, giving the next attack against them Advantage.
spells.scaling: Range, Effect: Can distract multiple creatures per SP spent.

spells.name: False Echoes
spells.effect: Your voice seems to come from multiple locations, confusing listeners. Lasts 30 sec.
spells.scaling: Range, Effect: Can project multiple voices or distort meaning.

spells.name: Shadow Step
spells.effect: Briefly step into a shadow, reappearing 5ft away.

spells.name: Obscuring Veil
spells.effect: Wrap yourself in illusory mist, making ranged attacks suffer Disadvantage for 1 min.

spells.name: Conceal Object
spells.effect: An object up to 1ft in size appears invisible for 5 min.

spells.name: Glamour Mask
spells.effect: Alter minor facial features, voice, or hair for 10 min.
spells.scaling: Duration, Effect: Allows larger physical alterations per SP spent.

spells.name: Veil of Shadows
spells.effect: Gain Advantage on Stealth checks for 10 min.

spells.name: False Passage
spells.effect: Creates a realistic illusory doorway, bridge, or tunnel that disappears upon interaction. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Muffled Step
spells.effect: Mutes your footsteps and movement for 5 min.

spells.name: Blur
spells.effect: The caster’s image distorts, giving attackers Disadvantage for 1 minute.

spells.name: Mirror Trick
spells.effect: A fake illusory duplicate of yourself appears in your space. Disappears when touched. Lasts 1 min.
spells.scaling: Effect: Can move 5ft per turn independently per SP spent.

spells.name: Displace Figure
spells.effect: Your form shifts unpredictably, giving attackers Major Disadvantage for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Flickering Image
spells.effect: Your form flickers unpredictably, giving you Disadvantage on enemy Perception checks. Lasts 1 min.
spells.scaling: Effect: Can turn fully invisible for 1 round per SP spent.

spells.name: Silence
spells.effect: Creates a 10ft zone of magical silence for 1 minute. No sound can be made in this area.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.effect: Create a larger illusion (creature-sized) with movement and sound. Lasts 1 min.
spells.scaling: Area, Effect: Can interact with environment per SP spent.

spells.name: Hallucination
spells.effect: A target sees a convincing illusion for 1 minute. Requires direct sight.
spells.scaling: Effect: Can affect multiple creatures per SP spent.

spells.name: Doppelgänger
spells.effect: Summon a perfect illusory clone of yourself. Mimics actions but cannot interact physically. Lasts 1 min.
spells.scaling: Effect: Can act semi-independently per SP spent.

spells.name: Phantom Pain
spells.effect: A target feels a false but intense pain, causing Disadvantage on all attacks for 3 rounds.
spells.scaling: Effect: Can stun for 1 turn per SP spent.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.effect: Turn one creature or object invisible for 1 minute.
spells.scaling: Duration, Effect: Can be extended to more creatures per SP spent.

spells.name: Shadow Bind
spells.effect: A target’s shadow grips them, halving their movement for 3 rounds.
spells.scaling: Effect: Can fully immobilize per SP spent.

spells.name: Illusory Terrain
spells.effect: Make a 10ft area appear different (pit, floor, water, etc.) for 10 min.

spells.name: False Sunlight
spells.effect: Create a blinding flash, imposing Disadvantage on all attacks for 2 rounds.
spells.scaling: Effect: Can cause Blindness for 1 round per SP spent.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.effect: A creature becomes Invisible for 1 minute; attacking or casting does not end it.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.effect: Draw a creature's deepest fear out of its mind and give it shape. Each round it must pass a TN 14 Willpower save or take 3D6 Psychic damage and become Frightened. Ends after 3 rounds or on a successful save.

spells.name: Mirage Arcane
spells.effect: Make up to a mile of terrain look, sound, smell and feel like different terrain for 24 hours. Structures can be hidden or added, but bear no weight. (Ritual)

spells.name: Mass Glamour
spells.effect: Disguise up to six creatures as anyone of similar build for 8 hours. Touch reveals nothing; only True Seeing or a TN 14 Investigation check does.

spells.name: Labyrinth of Mirrors
spells.effect: Trap a creature in an illusory maze for up to 1 minute (TN 14 Willpower to resist); it escapes with a TN 14 Intellect check at the end of each of its turns. To everyone else, it stands Incapacitated.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion
spells.effect: Set an illusion of up to a 30ft cube, with sound and movement, that plays out when a condition you name is met. Lasts until triggered or dispelled. (Ritual)

spells.name: Aegis
spells.effect: Raise a shimmering ward, gaining +2 TN until the start of your next turn. May be cast as a reaction when you are targeted by an attack.

spells.name: Kinetic Barrier
spells.effect: Ward a creature; the next 5 damage it takes is absorbed. Lasts 1 min or until depleted.
spells.scaling: Duration, Effect: absorbs +3 damage per step.

spells.name: Ward of Thresholds
spells.effect: Seal a door, window, gate or lid. Opening it requires a TN 12 Strength or Security check. Lasts 1 hour. (Ritual)
spells.scaling: Duration, Effect: +1 to the TN per step.

spells.name: Alarm Glyph
spells.effect: Inscribe an invisible glyph over a 20ft area. You are mentally alerted when any creature you did not name enters it. Lasts 8 hours. (Ritual)

spells.name: Dispel Minor
spells.effect: End one Basic spell or Miracle affecting a creature, object or 10ft area.

spells.name: Resist Element
spells.effect: Choose fire, frost, lightning or acid. The target takes half damage of that type for 1 min.

spells.name: Steady Mind
spells.effect: The target gains Advantage on its next Willpower save made within 1 min.

spells.name: Repelling Pulse
spells.effect: A burst of gravity shoves every creature within 5ft of you 10ft away (TN 10 Strength to resist).
spells.scaling: Area, Effect: +5ft of push per step.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.effect: End every Basic and Advanced spell, Miracle or enchantment on a creature, object or 15ft area. Against Master effects, your casting roll must reach 14.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.effect: Cast as a reaction when a creature in range casts a spell. Basic and Advanced spells fail outright; a Master spell fails only if your casting roll reaches 14. The enemy's SP is still spent.

spells.name: Deflection Field
spells.effect: A 10ft dome of bent space surrounds you. Ranged attacks made into it suffer Major Disadvantage. Lasts 3 rounds.

spells.name: Bulwark of Force
spells.effect: Ward a creature; the next 15 damage it takes is absorbed. Lasts 1 min or until depleted.
spells.scaling: Duration, Targets, Effect: absorbs +5 per step.

spells.name: Banishing Word
spells.effect: An Undead, Fiend or summoned creature must pass a TN 12 Willpower save or be hurled back to its grave or plane for 1 min. Creatures summoned by Basic or Advanced magic are banished permanently.

spells.name: Spell Ward
spells.effect: The target gains +2 TN against spell attacks and Advantage on saves against spells for 1 min.

spells.name: Warding Circle
spells.effect: Draw a 10ft circle and name a creature type (Undead, Fiend, Elemental, Beast, Aberration). Such creatures cannot enter the circle or attack across it unless they pass a TN 12 Willpower save each round. Lasts 10 min. (Ritual)

spells.name: Nullfield
spells.effect: Open a 10ft sphere of Void. Basic spells cannot be cast or sustained inside it, and Advanced spells cast inside it suffer Disadvantage. Lasts 3 rounds.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall
spells.effect: Raise a 60ft wall of layered, many-coloured radiance for 10 min. Any creature passing through takes 4D6 damage of a type rolled on 1D6 (fire, frost, lightning, acid, radiant, force) and must pass TN 14 or be Blinded for 1 round.

spells.name: Greater Ward
spells.effect: Ward a creature; the next 30 damage it takes is absorbed. Lasts 1 hour or until depleted.

spells.name: Antimagic Shell
spells.effect: A 10ft sphere centred on you in which no spell, Miracle or magic item functions, including your own. Lasts 1 min.

spells.name: Sanctum Seal
spells.effect: Ward a building up to 100ft square for 24 hours. It cannot be scried upon or teleported into or out of, and one named creature type cannot enter it. (Ritual)

spells.name: Reflective Ward
spells.effect: Cast as a reaction when you are targeted by a spell. The spell rebounds on its caster, who must resist it as normal.

spells.name: Abjure
spells.effect: A creature must pass a TN 14 Willpower save or be cast out of the material plane permanently. A creature native to this plane is instead imprisoned in a pocket of Void for 1 min.

spells.name: Conjure Flame
spells.effect: Create a flame in your hand that burns without fuel for 10 min. As a Major Action it may be thrown, dealing 1D6 Fire damage.

spells.name: Conjure Tool
spells.effect: Create a simple, non-magical object of up to 5 lbs (a rope, a crowbar, a lantern, a key blank). It vanishes after 1 hour.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.effect: An invisible force carries up to 30 lbs, opens doors, fetches and tidies at your command. Lasts 1 hour. (Ritual)

spells.name: Summon Familiar
spells.effect: Bind a spirit in the shape of a small animal to your service for 8 hours. It can deliver Touch spells for you, and you may see through its eyes as a Minor Action. (Ritual)

spells.name: Blink Step
spells.effect: Fold space and reappear up to 15ft away in a space you can see.

spells.name: Spectral Hand
spells.effect: A floating hand of force manipulates objects of up to 10 lbs; it cannot attack. Lasts 1 min.

spells.name: Grasping Mire
spells.effect: A 10ft area becomes sucking mud. It is Difficult Terrain, and a creature that starts its turn there must pass TN 10 Strength or be Restrained. Lasts 3 rounds.

spells.name: Summon Swarm
spells.effect: Rats, flies or carrion beetles fill a 10ft square. Creatures that start their turn inside take 1D6 Piercing damage. Lasts 3 rounds.

spells.name: Summon Beast
spells.effect: Call the spirit of a wolf, bear or great hawk to fight for you for 1 min (HP 15, TN 10, attack +3, 1D6+2 damage). It acts on your turn.

spells.name: Rift Step
spells.effect: Teleport up to 60ft, taking one willing creature you are touching with you.

spells.name: Teleport Object
spells.effect: Send an object of up to 50 lbs to a place you can see or know well within 1 mile.

spells.name: Conjure Barricade
spells.effect: Raise a wall of timber or rough stone, 20ft long and 10ft high, with 30 HP per 10ft section. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Hidden Coffer
spells.effect: Send a chest of up to 3ft in size into a pocket of folded space. You may recall it to your side as a Major Action at any time within the next week. (Ritual)

spells.name: Spectral Blades
spells.effect: Three conjured blades orbit you for 1 min. Once per round, as a Minor Action, one of them makes a spell attack against a creature within 30ft for 1D6 + Intellect Force damage.

spells.name: Binding Chains
spells.effect: Chains erupt from the ground beneath a creature, which must pass TN 12 Strength or be Restrained for 3 rounds. It may repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

spells.name: Phantom Steed
spells.effect: Conjure a horse of grey mist that moves 60ft per round and never tires. Lasts 1 hour. (Ritual)

spells.name: Summon Elemental
spells.effect: Call an elemental of fire, water, earth or air to serve you for 10 min (HP 40, TN 13, attack +5, 2D6+3 damage of its element).

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.effect: Transport yourself and up to 6 willing creatures to a location you know well within 100 miles, or to any permanent teleportation circle whose sigil you know. (Ritual)

spells.name: Planar Gate
spells.effect: Tear open a gate to another plane, such as the Astral Ocean, for 1 min. Anything may pass through it in either direction.

spells.name: Mage's Refuge
spells.effect: Open a door to a furnished extradimensional chamber large enough for 10 people. It is warm, lit, and unreachable from outside. Lasts 8 hours. (Ritual)

spells.name: Storm of Blades
spells.effect: Conjured steel whirls through a 20ft radius for 3 rounds. Any creature that starts its turn inside takes 3D6 Slashing damage (TN 14 Dexterity to resist for half).

spells.name: Bind Spirit
spells.effect: Summon a named spirit or lesser fiend and bind it (TN 14 Willpower to resist). It must answer three questions truthfully or perform one task within 1 hour. It will remember you.

spells.name: Mystic Insight
spells.effect: Sense magical auras within range and learn the school of each. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Detect Life
spells.effect: Sense the number and rough size of living creatures within range. Blocked by 3ft of stone or a sheet of lead. Lasts 1 min.

spells.name: Comprehend Tongues
spells.effect: Understand any spoken, written or signed language, including Kanin sign, for 10 min. You cannot speak it. (Ritual)

spells.name: Guidance
spells.effect: The target adds +2 to its next skill check made within 1 min.

spells.name: Foretold Strike
spells.effect: Cast as a Minor Action. Your next attack this turn is made with Advantage.

spells.name: Find the Path
spells.effect: Learn the direction of the nearest fresh water, safe shelter, or a named settlement within 10 miles. (Ritual)

spells.name: Read Object
spells.effect: Touch an object and witness a brief vision of its last owner, or the strongest emotion it was handled with.
spells.scaling: Effect: one further vision per step, going further back.

spells.name: Hunch
spells.effect: Ask the GM whether a course of action you will take in the next 10 min leads to weal, woe, both, or neither.

spells.name: Discern Lies
spells.effect: For 10 min you know whenever a creature you can hear tells a deliberate lie. A creature may pass a TN 12 Willpower save to mask it.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.effect: Sense the direction of an object you have seen within 1 mile. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.effect: Sense the direction of a creature you have met within 1 mile. Running water blocks the spell. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.effect: Place an invisible sensor in a familiar location within range and see or hear through it. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: See the Unseen
spells.effect: See invisible creatures and objects, and see through Basic Illusion spells. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Identify
spells.effect: Learn every property, charge, command word and curse of one magical item. (Ritual)

spells.name: Danger Sense
spells.effect: For 1 hour, you and allies within 30ft cannot be surprised and gain Advantage on Initiative.

spells.name: Read Thoughts
spells.effect: Hear the surface thoughts of a creature for 1 min (TN 12 Willpower to resist). It knows something touched its mind if it succeeds.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.effect: Use a reflective surface to watch and listen to a creature you know within 10 miles (100 miles with its hair, blood or a cherished possession). Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.effect: You gain Advantage on all rolls and cannot be surprised for 1 min.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.effect: See through illusions, invisibility, disguises and shapechanges, and see normally in magical darkness out to 60ft. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Astral Query
spells.effect: Cast your mind into the Astral Ocean and ask three questions. The answers are true, but rarely plain. Once per week. (Ritual)

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.effect: Name a person, place or object of significance and learn the legends, histories and rumours attached to it. (Ritual)

spells.name: Fate's Thread
spells.effect: Cast as a reaction after any creature within range rolls, before the outcome is known. Turn one of its dice to a 1 or a 6.

spells.name: Enthrall
spells.effect: A humanoid regards you as a friend for 1 hour or until harmed (TN 10 Willpower to resist). When the spell ends, it knows it was charmed.

spells.name: Command
spells.effect: Speak a single word (Halt, Drop, Kneel, Flee). The target obeys on its next turn (TN 10 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Daze
spells.effect: The target is Dazed until the end of its next turn (TN 10 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Inspire
spells.effect: An ally gains +1 to attack rolls and saves for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.effect: Up to three creatures in a 10ft area with 10 HP or fewer fall Unconscious for 1 min, or until they take damage or are shaken awake (TN 10 Willpower to resist).
spells.scaling: Area, Effect: +5 HP threshold per step.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.effect: Creatures in a 15ft area are no longer Frightened or Shaken and lose any hostile intent for 1 min unless attacked (TN 10 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Taunt
spells.effect: The target suffers Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the end of its next turn (TN 10 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Lapse
spells.effect: The target forgets the last minute (TN 10 Willpower to resist). It is aware that time has been lost.

spells.name: Compel
spells.effect: Suggest a reasonable course of action to a humanoid. It follows it for up to 8 hours or until it is completed (TN 12 Willpower to resist). Obviously harmful suggestions fail.

spells.name: Fear
spells.effect: Creatures in a 30ft cone are Frightened of you for 1 min (TN 12 Willpower to resist), repeating the save at the end of each of their turns.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.effect: A humanoid is Paralyzed (TN 12 Willpower to resist). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, for up to 1 min.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.effect: Up to four allies cannot be Frightened and gain 1D6 temporary HP at the start of each of their turns for 1 min.

spells.name: Discord
spells.effect: Up to three creatures in a 20ft area attack the nearest creature, friend or foe, on their next turn (TN 12 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Silver Voice
spells.effect: For 10 min you have Advantage on Persuasion, Deception and Diplomacy checks, and those you sway do not realise magic was involved.

spells.name: Fog of Doubt
spells.effect: Creatures in a 20ft area suffer Disadvantage on Intellect checks and Willpower saves for 3 rounds (TN 12 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Bloodlust
spells.effect: An ally gains Advantage on melee attacks and +1D6 melee damage for 3 rounds, but must attack the nearest enemy each turn. Works on Beasts.

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.effect: Take control of a humanoid for 10 min (TN 14 Willpower to resist). It repeats the save whenever ordered to act against its nature.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.effect: Suggest a course of action to up to six creatures within range. It lasts up to 24 hours (TN 14 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Binding Oath
spells.effect: Lay a magical oath on a creature (TN 14 Willpower to resist). Each day it acts against the oath, it takes 2D6 Psychic damage. Lasts 30 days.

spells.name: Rout
spells.effect: Every enemy within 40ft must pass a TN 14 Willpower save or become Frightened and flee from you for 1 min. Regiments break before it.

spells.name: Modify Memory
spells.effect: Rewrite up to 10 minutes of a creature's memories from the last 24 hours (TN 14 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Shatter Will
spells.effect: Crush a mind beneath your own: 4D6 Psychic damage and the target is Stunned (TN 14 Willpower to resist for half damage and no Stun).

spells.name: Necrotic Touch
spells.effect: 1D6 Necrotic damage, and the target suffers -1 to Strength-based rolls for 1 min (TN 10 Strength to resist the penalty).

spells.name: Grave Chill
spells.effect: 1D6 Necrotic damage. The target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Leech
spells.effect: 1D6 Necrotic damage; you regain HP equal to half the damage dealt.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.effect: A corpse with a mouth or skull answers three questions, knowing only what it knew in life. A corpse can only be questioned once every 10 days. (Ritual)

spells.name: Last Breath
spells.effect: A creature at 0 HP is stabilised and is no longer Doomed.

spells.name: Deathsight
spells.effect: For 1 min you see the life in living things as a glow: you know whether each creature in range is unhurt, wounded, or near death, and you see Undead clearly.

spells.name: Rot
spells.effect: Spoil food and drink, or rot rope, wood, cloth or leather, in a 5ft cube.

spells.name: Animate Bones
spells.effect: Raise the skeleton or corpse of a small beast to serve you for 10 min (HP 6, TN 8, 1D6 damage).

spells.name: Ray of Pestilence
spells.effect: A black beam deals 2D6 Necrotic damage, and the target deals half damage for 3 rounds (TN 12 Strength to resist the weakness).

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.effect: Raise a zombie or skeleton from a humanoid corpse, under your command for 24 hours (HP 12, TN 9, 1D6+2 damage).

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.effect: 2D6 Necrotic damage; you regain HP equal to half the damage dealt.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.effect: Choose one: Disadvantage on rolls with one attribute; 1D6 Necrotic damage whenever it attacks you; or it cannot regain HP. Lasts 1 hour (TN 12 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.effect: End every Basic and Advanced curse, hex or necrotic affliction on a creature or object.

spells.name: Blight
spells.effect: Drain the life from a creature: 2D6 Necrotic damage. Plants and plant-like creatures take maximum damage.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.effect: A willing creature appears dead to every test, mundane or magical, for 1 hour. It is immune to poison while the spell lasts and can end it at will.

spells.name: Grave Wail
spells.effect: A wail of the dead: creatures within 15ft take 1D6 Necrotic damage and are Frightened for 1 round (TN 12 Willpower to resist both).

spells.name: Finger of Decay
spells.effect: 4D6 Necrotic damage, and the target is Paralyzed for 1 min (TN 14 Strength to resist the paralysis, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns).

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.effect: Raise up to three ghouls (HP 20, TN 11, 2D6 damage; their claws Paralyze for 1 round on a failed TN 12 save). They obey you for 24 hours, and you may recast to keep them.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.effect: A ring of void spreads outwards: 4D6 Necrotic damage to every creature in a 30ft radius (TN 14 Strength to resist for half).

spells.name: Revivify
spells.effect: Return a creature that died within the last minute to life with 1 HP. It gains one tier of Exhausted. Fails if the body was destroyed or the soul is unwilling.

spells.name: Soul Cage
spells.effect: Cast as a reaction when a creature dies within range. Its soul is trapped in a gem you hold; it cannot be revived while caged, and you may question it once per day.

spells.name: Withering Plague
spells.effect: The target and every creature within 10ft are Poisoned and take 1D6 Necrotic damage each round for 1 min (TN 14 Strength to resist, repeated each round). Anyone who touches a victim must save too.

spells.name: Graceful Descent
spells.effect: Up to five falling creatures drift down gently and take no fall damage. Lasts 1 min or until they land. May be cast as a reaction.

spells.name: Arcane Mending
spells.effect: Repair a single break or tear in an object up to 3ft in size, restoring it to working order.
spells.scaling: Effect: +3ft of object size per step.

spells.name: Tint
spells.effect: Change the colour, texture or smell of an object or surface up to a 10ft cube for 1 hour.

spells.name: Enlarge / Reduce
spells.effect: A creature or object doubles or halves in size for 1 min. Enlarged: +1D6 melee damage and Advantage on Strength checks. Reduced: -1D6 melee damage and Advantage on Stealth (TN 10 Strength to resist if unwilling).

spells.name: Quicken
spells.effect: The target gains +10ft movement and may Dash as a Minor Action for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Hardened Hide
spells.effect: The target's skin toughens like bark, granting +1 TN for 10 min.

spells.name: Spider Climb
spells.effect: The target can climb walls and ceilings at full speed with its hands free. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Purify
spells.effect: Cleanse up to five gallons of water or a day's food for ten of poison, rot and disease. (Ritual)

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.effect: Mould up to a 10ft cube of stone into any shape you can imagine: a doorway, a stair, a sealed wall.

spells.name: Haste
spells.effect: For 3 rounds the target gains +10ft movement, +1 TN, and an extra Major Action each turn (attack, Dash or use an item only). When the spell ends, it is Slowed for 1 round.

spells.name: Slow
spells.effect: Up to three creatures in a 20ft area are Slowed for 3 rounds (TN 12 Dexterity to resist).

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.effect: The target takes half damage from non-magical slashing, piercing and bludgeoning attacks for 10 min.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.effect: Up to six creatures can breathe underwater for 8 hours. (Ritual)

spells.name: Flight
spells.effect: The target gains a flying speed of 40ft for 1 min.

spells.name: Knock
spells.effect: Open every lock, bar, chain or manacle on one door or creature. A magical lock instead requires your casting roll to reach 12 again.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.effect: Gain one change for 10 min: gills and webbed hands, claws (1D6 + Strength damage), or eyes that see in darkness out to 60ft.
spells.scaling: Duration, Effect: one additional change per step.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.effect: Transform a creature into a beast of equal or smaller size for 1 hour. It keeps its mind but takes the beast's HP, TN and attacks (TN 14 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Flesh to Stone
spells.effect: The target is Restrained as its body hardens (TN 14 Strength to resist). If it fails a second save at the end of its next turn, it is Petrified.

spells.name: Transmute Matter
spells.effect: Turn up to 1 cubic foot of one material into another (lead to silver, stone to iron, wood to glass) for 24 hours. Made permanent by consuming radianite worth 500gp. (Ritual)

spells.name: Reverse Gravity
spells.effect: In a 30ft radius, everything that isn't anchored falls upwards for 3 rounds, then falls back down (normal fall damage).

spells.name: Unmake
spells.effect: A thread of pure Void deals 5D6 Force damage. A creature or object reduced to 0 HP by it crumbles to dust.

spells.name: Shape the Land
spells.effect: Over 10 minutes, raise, sink or reshape up to a 40ft cube of earth, sand or rock. (Ritual)

spells.name: Stutter
spells.effect: The target skips a beat in time and loses its Minor Action and movement on its next turn (TN 12 Willpower to resist).

spells.name: Rewind
spells.effect: Cast as a reaction when an ally within range takes damage from an attack. Undo the damage and the attack; the attacker's turn continues.

spells.name: Borrowed Moment
spells.effect: Take a full additional turn immediately after this one. Afterwards you gain one tier of Exhausted.

spells.name: Stasis
spells.effect: A creature or object is frozen in time for 1 hour (TN 14 Willpower to resist). It cannot act, age, or be harmed.

spells.name: Blood Price
spells.effect: Cast as a Minor Action. The next spell you cast this turn may be paid for with HP instead of SP, at 2 HP per SP.

spells.name: Boil Blood
spells.effect: 2D6 Fire damage, and the target is Bleeding (TN 12 Strength to resist the Bleeding).

spells.name: Puppet Strings
spells.effect: Seize control of the body (not the mind) of a Bleeding creature for 3 rounds (TN 14 Strength to resist, repeated each round). You choose its movement and attacks.

spells.name: Sanguine Bond
spells.effect: Bind your blood to a willing ally for 1 hour. Damage taken by either of you is split evenly between you.

spells.name: Stone Ward
spells.effect: While standing on earth or stone, the target gains +3 TN against physical attacks for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Earthen Grasp
spells.effect: Hands of stone seize every creature in a 15ft radius, Restraining them (TN 12 Strength to resist). Lasts 3 rounds.

spells.name: Rampart
spells.effect: Raise a permanent stone wall 60ft long and 15ft high, with 50 HP per 10ft section.

spells.name: Living Bastion
spells.effect: Clad yourself in living rock for 1 min: half damage from all physical attacks, +2 TN, and you cannot be moved or knocked Prone. Your movement drops to 10ft.

spells.name: Heal Wounds
spells.effect: A creature you touch regains 1D6 + Charisma HP.

spells.name: Bless
spells.effect: Up to three allies gain +1 to attack rolls and saves for 3 rounds.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.effect: Radiance falls upon a creature: 1D6 Radiant damage, and it gains no benefit from cover against this miracle (TN 10 Dexterity to resist).

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.effect: Any creature that tries to attack the warded target must first pass a TN 10 Willpower save or choose another target. Ends if the target attacks. Lasts 1 min.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.effect: The target gains +2 TN for 1 min.

spells.name: Rebuke
spells.effect: Cast as a reaction when a creature within range damages an ally: 1D6 Radiant damage to that creature.

spells.name: Last Rites
spells.effect: A creature at 0 HP is stabilised and no longer Doomed; or a corpse is given rest, and can never be raised as Undead. (Ritual)

spells.name: Sense the Unclean
spells.effect: Sense the presence and direction of Undead, Fiends and desecrated ground within range for 10 min.

spells.name: Guiding Word
spells.effect: The target adds +2 to its next roll of any kind made within 1 min.

spells.name: Consecrate Water
spells.effect: Bless a flask of water. Thrown, it deals 2D6 Radiant damage to an Undead or Fiend. Holds its blessing for a day. (Ritual)

spells.name: Mass Heal Wounds
spells.effect: Every ally within a 15ft radius regains 2D6 HP.

spells.name: Restoration
spells.effect: End one of the following on a creature: Poisoned, Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Crippled, a disease, or one tier of Exhausted.
spells.scaling: Targets, Effect: one more condition per step.

spells.name: Turn the Profane
spells.effect: Every Undead and Fiend within 30ft must pass a TN 12 Willpower save or be Frightened of you and flee for 1 min.

spells.name: Host of the Faithful
spells.effect: Spectral guardians of your god circle you within 15ft for 1 min. Enemies in the area have their movement halved and take 2D6 Radiant damage when they start their turn there (TN 12 Willpower to resist for half).

spells.name: Brand of the Heretic
spells.effect: 2D6 Radiant damage, and the target glows for 1 min: it cannot become Invisible or hidden, and attacks against it gain +1.

spells.name: Aegis of the Faith
spells.effect: Up to four allies gain +1 TN and cannot be Frightened for 10 min.

spells.name: Augury
spells.effect: Ask your patron whether a course of action you will take within the next 30 min brings weal, woe, both or neither. The answer is sometimes a sign rather than a word. (Ritual)

spells.name: Break Enchantment
spells.effect: End every Basic and Advanced charm, compulsion, curse or possession on a creature.

spells.name: Truthbound
spells.effect: For 10 min, creatures within 15ft of a point you choose cannot knowingly speak a lie (TN 12 Willpower to resist). Those affected know they are bound.

spells.name: Beacon of Hope
spells.effect: For 1 min, up to four allies gain Advantage on Willpower saves, and any healing they receive is maximised.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.effect: End every condition, curse, possession and reduction to maximum HP affecting a creature.

spells.name: Raise the Fallen
spells.effect: Return to life a creature dead no longer than 10 days whose soul is willing. It returns with 1 HP and two tiers of Exhausted. Your patron may ask a price. (Ritual)

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.effect: Every ally within 30ft regains 4D6 HP and is cured of Bleeding and Poisoned.

spells.name: Wrath of the Pantheon
spells.effect: A column of holy fire 20ft wide strikes: 4D6 Radiant or Fire damage to every creature inside (TN 14 Dexterity to resist for half).

spells.name: Holy Aura
spells.effect: For 1 min, allies within 30ft gain +2 TN and Advantage on saves. An Undead or Fiend that strikes one of them must pass TN 14 or be Blinded for 1 round.

spells.name: Divine Word
spells.effect: Speak a word of your god's true name. Every Undead and Fiend within 30ft must pass a TN 14 Willpower save; those with 20 HP or fewer are destroyed or banished, and the rest are Stunned.
spells.scaling: Area, Effect: +10 HP threshold per step.

spells.name: Call the Herald
spells.effect: Summon an emissary of your patron to aid you for 10 min (HP 40, TN 13, flies 40ft, attack +5, 2D6+3 Radiant damage). It will refuse any task that offends its god.

spells.name: Sanctify
spells.effect: Consecrate an area 60ft across for a year and a day. Undead and Fiends cannot enter it without passing a TN 14 Willpower save, and allies inside have Advantage on saves against fear and charm. (Ritual)
